excerpt.en: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].

texts.en: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].

sections.en: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]上的动物——不论是捕食者还是猎物——都会在夜幕降临的时候聚集在一起，然后……唱歌。

嚎叫、咔哒声、叽喳声、咆哮、嘘声混在一起，初听来呕哑嘲哳难为听，但其细听却能发现潜藏着一种可以辨认的旋律。[Root.GetName]上的船员也说那种音乐甚至还挺好听的。

我们认为必然有外来影响干涉才能创造出这种非智慧生物的合唱。我们无法放理解其原因，但至少我们可以研究他们是如何做到的。
texts.en:
The animals of [From.GetName] - predator and prey alike - gather together as night falls and... sing.

The howls, clicks, chirps, roars and hisses seem discordant at first, but underneath lies a recognizable melody. The crew of the [Root.GetName] suggest it's even rather pleasant to hear.

We believe an external influence must have interfered in order to develop this non-sapient choir. We cannot fathom as to why, however we may be able to figure out how they did it.

label.zh: 还是通过化学来交流比较好。

texts.zh:
虽说[From.GetName]上的大部分建筑都已成废墟，但还有少数得以留存。[Root.GetName]初次经过该星球时只发现了一座还算完整的建筑，孤零零地耸立在[From.GetName]的废墟之中。

这便是噪音的来源。

该建筑不仅结构完整，据科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]称，似乎还存在活动迹象。

那是一座生产设施，专门将塑料聚合物制成不明的物体，不过似乎是用于装饰的。其生产原料与最终产品对[Root.Owner.GetName]来说没有研究价值，但我们可以对其自动化的生产过程进行研究。
texts.en:
There are structures on [From.GetName], though most are less than ruins and more akin to rubble. The [Root.GetName]'s initial pass over the planet reveals only one building that can be considered intact, seemingly spared whatever calamity robbed [From.GetName] of its buildings and builders alike.

This is the source of the noise.

Not only is the building intact, reports Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], but it is active.

It is a production facility of some sort, turning plasticine polymers into mute objects of uncertain, but possibly ornamental, purpose. The raw materials and end product are largely uninteresting to the [Root.Owner.GetName], but we could doubtlessly stand to learn something from the automated manufacturing process itself.

label.zh: 也许我们应该建立据点并进行观察。
label.en: Perhaps we should establish a foothold and observe.
